source_record_subset.mysql: SELECT CAST( SUM( CASE WHEN `sex` = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS DOUBLE ) * 100 / COUNT( `id` ) FROM `patient` WHERE `diagnosis` = 'RA' AND DATE_FORMAT( CAST( `birthday` AS DATETIME ) , '%Y' ) = '1980'
source_record_subset.cracksql: SELECT CAST( SUM( CASE WHEN "sex" = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS DOUBLE PRECISION ) * 100 / COUNT( "id" ) FROM "patient" WHERE "diagnosis" = 'RA' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST( "birthday" AS TIMESTAMP )) = '1980'
